description.nature: A partner's API endpoint receiving shared customer records was exposed without authentication.
description.extent: About 52,000 customer records could be queried over about 11 days; how many were queried is not yet known.
description.likelyImpact: Exposure of customer identifiers and transaction summaries.
description.eventsCircumstancesReasons: The partner deployed an API endpoint without authentication; records were retrievable by URL pattern.

implemented: Data sharing with the partner suspended
proposed: Require authentication and access logging in partner API contracts
